Name: Edible Rare Fruits
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
A very simple edit to make both Ancient Fruit and Sweet Gem Berry edible.

Ancient Fruit:
Normal > 125 Energy + 56 Health
Silver > 175 Energy + 78 Health
Gold > 225 Energy + 101 Health
Iridium > 325 Energy + 146 Health

Sweet Gem Berry:
Normal > 200 Energy + 90 Health
Silver > 280 Energy + 126 Health
Gold > 360 Energy + 162 Health
Iridium > 520 Energy + 234 Health
